verdict.rationale: Orama's docs describe a Faceted Search API that generates facets at search time when you set a `facets` property in the search configuration, so facets come back from the same query. The docs explicitly name category, price range and other attributes as filter dimensions. The evidence never states that facets return per-value live counts, and range facets get only a passing mention. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-value facet counts, detail on range facet configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build faceted navigation — filters with live counts across categories, ranges, and attributes — from a single query

citations.quote: users can filter their search results by various criteria, such as category, price range, or other attributes
Orama will be able to generate facets at search-time based on the schema. To do so, we need to specify the facets property in the search configuration
the Orama Faceted Search API is the perfect solution for adding faceted search functionality to your project
